## Featured Property Developments

- [The Core Mall, Ghaziabad](https://satsaisunrisereality.com/The-Core-Mall/): Modern commercial hub located at Plot-CC1, Sushant Aquapolis, directly opposite Crossings Republik on NH-24 (14-lane Delhi-Meerut Expressway). Features double-height high-street retail shops, designer galleria boutiques, food court decks, and corporate office suites. Investment starts from ₹25 Lakhs with Day One rental income potential up to ₹1.8 Lakhs per annum.
- [Heaven in the Forest](https://satsaisunrisereality.com/Heaven-in-the-forest/): Luxury Himalayan mountain villas and scenic retreat apartments nestled near Kainchi Dham, Uttarakhand. Ideal for holiday homes and high-occupancy boutique vacation rentals.
- [The Aarambh Resorts](https://satsaisunrisereality.com/Aarambh%20Resort/): Eco-luxury resort plots, cottages, and hospitality real estate situated near Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand.

## Property Categories & Investment Formats

- Commercial Retail: Double-height showrooms, high-footfall atrium shops, and boutique galleria units with immediate rental income.
- Food & Beverage Spaces: Dedicated food court counters, quick-service restaurant (QSR) outlets, and open-air terrace dining decks with turnkey kitchen infrastructure.
- Commercial Office Suites: Professional business spaces with dedicated elevators, conference facilities, and rapid access to Noida Sector 62 and central NCR.
- Luxury Residential: Master-planned villas, premium apartments, and second-home mountain retreats.
- Plots & Land: High-growth freehold plots in major transit corridors (NH-24, Delhi-Meerut Expressway, Yamuna Expressway).
